# cosmo_api_key (Resource)

Manages an organization API key in Cosmo, for use with the Cosmo CLI (`wgc`), CI pipelines or this provider. The key receives the permissions of the organization group it is assigned to.

The secret `key` is only returned by Cosmo when the key is created. It is stored in the Terraform state, so protect your state accordingly. Imported keys have no `key` value.

Requires an API key with the `organization-admin` or `organization-apikey-manager` role. Only organization admins can create keys in a group that grants `organization-admin`.

For more information on API keys, please refer to the [Cosmo Documentation](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/studio/api-keys).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmo_organization_group" "ci" {
  name        = var.group_name
  description = "Publishes subgraphs from CI"

  rules = [
    { role = "subgraph-publisher" },
  ]
}

resource "cosmo_api_key" "ci" {
  name     = var.name
  group_id = cosmo_organization_group.ci.id
  expires  = "1_year"
}

# Keys can also join an existing group, such as the built-in admin group.
# data "cosmo_organization_group" "admin" {
#   name = "admin"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the organization group whose permissions the key receives, for example `cosmo_organization_group.example.id`. This can be changed without recreating the key.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key, unique within the organization (3 to 50 characters). Changing this recreates the key.

### Optional

- `expires` (String) How long the key is valid for, counted from creation. One of `never`, `30_days`, `6_months` or `1_year`. Defaults to `never`. Changing this recreates the key.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Additional permissions for the key, such as `scim`. Cosmo does not return permissions when reading a key, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. Changing this recreates the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the key.
- `expires_at` (String) When the key expires (RFC 3339). Empty if the key never expires.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the API key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The secret API key value. Only available for keys created by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# API keys can be imported using the name of the key. The secret value cannot be
# recovered, so the imported resource has no `key`.
terraform import cosmo_api_key.example ci-publisher
```
